_README: Landmark coordinates for a Greek spec that delimits its zone as a line through named places
("οριοθετείται από την διαχωριστική γραμμή Δροσιά- Άνοιξη- …"). The resolver draws the polygon
those places outline, in the order the text names them, each place at the point given here
(scripts/_lib/gr/geometry.py, units_union). Keys: record slug → {name exactly as the parser
emits it → {lat, lon, source}}. Sources must be public and licence-clear: Wikidata (CC0,
cite the item) or GeoNames (CC BY 4.0, cite the id). A place with no located point is
listed on the card as not drawn; the polygon then runs straight between its neighbours.

Αγ. Γεώργιος Βρανά.source: wikidata:Q24882385 (Βρανάς Αττικής, the village whose church the text names)

_unlocated.playies-pentelikou: Κουκουνάρι (a locality) and Σταματοβούνι (the hill above Σταμάτα) are in neither Wikidata nor the GeoNames GR dump (2026-09-25); the polygon runs straight from Βρανάς to Διόνυσος until a licence-clear gazetteer locates them.
